recipe.title: Grandma’s Apple Crisp
recipe.description: My Grandma's recipe for warm homemade apple crisp, served like bars and topped with vanilla ice cream. There’s no place like home, except Grandma’s.
instructions: Combine the first three ingredients and place in a greased 8×8 baking dish.
Combine the remaining ingredients and sprinkle over the top of the apple mixture.
Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream!
